shopName.label: Shop Name
shopName.description: The part before .myshopify.com in your store URL. For https://example.myshopify.com, enter example.

adminToken.label: Admin Token
adminToken.description: The Admin API access token of a custom app made in the Shopify admin (Settings, Apps and sales channels, Develop apps), with the Admin API scopes the actions use.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: From the order's URL in Shopify admin, not its #1001 number.

parent_id.label: Parent Transaction ID
parent_id.description: The transaction to capture, void or refund.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Required for refunds and captures on multi-currency orders.

authorization.label: Authorization Key
authorization.description: The authorization code for this transaction.

source.label: Source
source.description: Set to external to record a cash payment made outside Shopify.

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: The number at the end of the product's URL in Shopify admin.

activate_inventory_at_location.label: Stock Item at Location
activate_inventory_at_location.description: Start tracking an inventory item at a location, optionally with a starting quantity.

inventory_item_id.label: Inventory Item ID
inventory_item_id.description: The inventory item id, numeric or "gid://shopify/InventoryItem/…" (from get_product_variant_details).

location_id.label: Location ID
location_id.description: The location id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Location/…" (from list_locations).

available.label: Starting Available Quantity
available.description: Optional whole-number available quantity to start with, for example 10.

idempotency_key.label: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this operation, for example a UUID such as "3f1c2a9e-6b1d-4c8e-9a51-2f7d0e4b8c10". Generate your own key on the first call and pass the same key again when retrying after a timeout or error, so Shopify does not repeat the operation. It is returned as idempotency_key and included in any error message.

add_discount_redeem_codes.label: Start Adding Discount Redeem Codes
add_discount_redeem_codes.description: Start adding up to 250 new redeem codes to a code discount (runs in the background).

discount_id.label: Discount ID
discount_id.description: The code discount id, for example "gid://shopify/DiscountCodeNode/123" or "123". Get it from list_discounts or find_discount_by_code.

codes.label: Codes
codes.description: The new codes, 1 to 250, for example "WELCOME-A1B2". Duplicates in the list are sent once.

add_product_media.label: Add Product Media
add_product_media.description: Add images, videos or 3D models to a product from public URLs.

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: The product id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Product/…". Find it with search_products.

media.label: Media
media.description: The media to add, one entry per file.

add_products_to_collection.label: Add Products to Collection
add_products_to_collection.description: Add products to a collection by hand.

collection_id.label: Collection ID
collection_id.description: The collection id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Collection/…". Find it with search_collections.

source_id.label: Source ID
source_id.description: Optional conditions source to add the picks to (from get_collection sources). Must not be a shared source. Defaults to the first non-shared conditions source.

add_tags.label: Add Tags
add_tags.description: Add tags to an order, draft order, customer, product or blog article.

resource_type.label: Resource Type
resource_type.description: What kind of record the id belongs to. Used to build the full id when a numeric id is given.

resource_id.label: Resource ID
resource_id.description: Numeric id such as "450789469" or a full id such as "gid://shopify/Order/450789469".

list_delivery_zones.label: List Delivery Zones
list_delivery_zones.description: List every shipping zone of one location group in a delivery profile, with countries and rates.

profile_id.label: Delivery Profile ID
profile_id.description: The profile id from list_delivery_profiles, numeric or "gid://shopify/DeliveryProfile/…".

location_group_id.label: Location Group ID
location_group_id.description: The location_group_id from list_delivery_profiles, numeric or "gid://shopify/DeliveryLocationGroup/…".

first.label: Page Size
first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 25. Defaults to 25.

after.label: Cursor
after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

zone_token.label: Zone Token
zone_token.description: To read more rates of one zone: that zone's zone_token from a previous call. Returns only that zone.

rates_after.label: Rates Cursor
rates_after.description: With zone_token: the zone's rates_end_cursor from a previous call, to read its next 50 rates.

delete_analytics_annotation.label: Delete Analytics Annotation
delete_analytics_annotation.description: Remove an analytics annotation this app created.

annotation_id.label: Analytics Annotation ID
annotation_id.description: The annotation id, numeric or "gid://shopify/AnalyticsAnnotation/…", as returned by create_analytics_annotation.

update_analytics_annotation.label: Update Analytics Annotation
update_analytics_annotation.description: Change the type, title, description or dates of an analytics annotation this app created.

annotation_id.label: Analytics Annotation ID
annotation_id.description: The annotation id, numeric or "gid://shopify/AnalyticsAnnotation/…", as returned by create_analytics_annotation.

type.label: Type
type.description: New kind of event. Leave empty to keep it.

title.label: Title
title.description: New chart marker text, at most 75 characters. Leave empty to keep it.

description.label: Description
description.description: New plain-text context, at most 150 characters. Leave empty to keep it.

clear_description.label: Clear Description
clear_description.description: Remove the description. Do not combine with Description.

started_at.label: Started At
started_at.description: New start, ISO 8601 with a time zone, for example 2026-11-28T00:00:00Z. Leave empty to keep it.

ended_at.label: Ended At
ended_at.description: New end, ISO 8601 with a time zone. Leave empty to keep it.

make_open_ended.label: Make Open-Ended
make_open_ended.description: Remove the end so the event shows as still running. Do not combine with Ended At.

create_analytics_annotation.label: Create Analytics Annotation
create_analytics_annotation.description: Mark a notable event (launch, campaign, redesign…) on the store's analytics charts.

type.label: Type
type.description: The kind of event, for example campaign, product_launch, store_redesign or other.

title.label: Title
title.description: Text shown on the chart marker, at most 75 characters.

description.label: Description
description.description: Optional extra context, plain text, at most 150 characters.

started_at.label: Started At
started_at.description: When the event started, ISO 8601 with a time zone, for example 2026-11-28T00:00:00Z.

ended_at.label: Ended At
ended_at.description: When the event ended, ISO 8601 with a time zone. Leave empty for a point-in-time marker. Must not be before Started At.

open_ended.label: Open-Ended
open_ended.description: The event is still running and has no end yet. Do not combine with Ended At.

delete_analytics_targets.label: Delete Analytics Targets
delete_analytics_targets.description: Permanently delete one or more analytics targets.

target_ids.label: Analytics Target IDs
target_ids.description: Targets to delete, numeric or "gid://shopify/AnalyticsTarget/…". Find them with list_analytics_targets.

update_analytics_target.label: Update Analytics Target
update_analytics_target.description: Change the name, metric, dates, goal value or filters of an analytics target.

target_id.label: Analytics Target ID
target_id.description: The target id, numeric or "gid://shopify/AnalyticsTarget/…". Find it with list_analytics_targets.

name.label: Name
name.description: New label for the target. Leave empty to keep it.

metric.label: Metric
metric.description: New ShopifyQL metric identifier, for example total_sales or orders. Leave empty to keep it.

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: New first day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to keep it.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: New last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to keep it.

expected_value.label: Expected Value
expected_value.description: New goal value, greater than 0. Leave empty to keep it.

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: New ShopifyQL filter expression, for example shipping_country = 'US'. Leave empty to keep the current filters.

clear_filters.label: Clear Filters
clear_filters.description: Remove the filters so the target tracks the whole store. Do not combine with Filters.

create_analytics_target.label: Create Analytics Target
create_analytics_target.description: Set a goal for an analytics metric over a date range, shown in Shopify Analytics.

name.label: Name
name.description: Label for the target, for example "Q1 Sales Target".

metric.label: Metric
metric.description: ShopifyQL metric identifier in lower case, for example total_sales or orders. Shopify rejects metrics that cannot have a target (INVALID_METRIC).

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: First day of the target period, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: Last day of the target period, YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before the start date.

expected_value.label: Expected Value
expected_value.description: The goal value, greater than 0 (for money metrics, an amount in the shop currency).

filters.label: Filters
filters.description: Optional ShopifyQL filter expression that narrows the data, for example shipping_country = 'US'. Leave empty to track the whole store.

list_analytics_targets.label: List Analytics Targets
list_analytics_targets.description: List and search the store's analytics targets (goals for a metric over a date range).

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify search syntax, for example "metric:total_sales" or "start_date:>=2026-01-01 end_date:<=2026-12-31". Leave empty to list all.

sort_key.label: Sort By
sort_key.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to ID.

reverse.label: Reverse Order
reverse.description: Return results in reverse sort order (for example newest first).

first.label: Page Size
first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

after.label: Cursor
after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

get_return_policy_profile.label: Get Return Policy Profile
get_return_policy_profile.description: Get one return policy profile with its return and cancellation rules and markets.

return_policy_profile_id.label: Return Policy Profile ID
return_policy_profile_id.description: The profile id, numeric or "gid://shopify/ReturnPolicyProfile/…". Find it with list_return_policy_profiles or in a market's return_policy_profile_id.

list_return_policy_profiles.label: List Return Policy Profiles
list_return_policy_profiles.description: List the store's return policy profiles with their return and cancellation rules and markets.

default.label: Default Profile Only
default.description: Yes returns only the default profile, No only the custom profiles. Leave empty for all.

reverse.label: Reverse Order
reverse.description: Return results in reverse sort order (for example newest first).

first.label: Page Size
first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 25. Defaults to 25.

after.label: Cursor
after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

list_market_relationships.label: List Market Relationships
list_market_relationships.description: List the parent/child links between the store's Markets.

reverse.label: Reverse Order
reverse.description: Return results in reverse sort order (for example newest first).

first.label: Page Size
first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

after.label: Cursor
after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

get_market.label: Get Market
get_market.description: Get one Shopify Market with its conditions, hierarchy, catalogs, currency and return policy.

market_id.label: Market ID
market_id.description: The market id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Market/…". Find it with list_markets.

list_markets.label: List Markets
list_markets.description: List and search the store's Shopify Markets with their hierarchy, regions, currency and return policy.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify markets search syntax, for example "status:ACTIVE", "name:Europe" or "market_type:REGION". Leave empty to list all.

type.label: Market Type
type.description: Only return markets of this type. Leave empty for all types.

sort_key.label: Sort By
sort_key.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to NAME.

reverse.label: Reverse Order
reverse.description: Return results in reverse sort order (for example newest first).

first.label: Page Size
first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 15. Defaults to 15.

after.label: Cursor
after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

send_payment_method_update_email.label: Send Payment Method Update Email
send_payment_method_update_email.description: Email a customer a secure link to add a new payment method for an order, draft order or subscription contract.

resource_type.label: Resource Type
resource_type.description: What the new payment method is for.

resource_id.label: Resource ID
resource_id.description: The id of the order, draft order or subscription contract, numeric or a full id such as "gid://shopify/Order/450789469", "gid://shopify/DraftOrder/…" or "gid://shopify/SubscriptionContract/…". It must match the resource type; Shopify receives the number.

from.label: Sender Email
from.description: Send from this address instead of the store default, for example "support@example.com".

bcc.label: BCC Recipients
bcc.description: Email addresses that receive a blind copy, for example ["owner@example.com"].

resolve_requested_order_edit.label: Resolve Requested Order Edit
resolve_requested_order_edit.description: Mark a buyer request to edit an order as completed.

requested_order_edit_id.label: Requested Order Edit ID
requested_order_edit_id.description: The requested order edit id, numeric or "gid://shopify/RequestedOrderEdit/…". Find it with list_requested_order_edits.

decline_requested_order_edit.label: Decline Requested Order Edit
decline_requested_order_edit.description: Decline a buyer request to edit an order, with an optional note to the buyer.

requested_order_edit_id.label: Requested Order Edit ID
requested_order_edit_id.description: The requested order edit id, numeric or "gid://shopify/RequestedOrderEdit/…". Find it with list_requested_order_edits.

decline_note.label: Decline Note
decline_note.description: Message sent to the buyer explaining the decline, at most 500 characters. Leave empty to send none.

create_requested_order_edit.label: Create Requested Order Edit
create_requested_order_edit.description: Record a buyer request to remove unfulfilled line items from an order.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…". Find it with search_orders.

line_items.label: Line Items to Remove
line_items.description: The order line items the buyer wants removed and how many units of each. Line item ids come from get_order (line_items[].id). The quantity cannot exceed the unfulfilled quantity of the line item.

calculate_requested_order_edit.label: Calculate Requested Order Edit
calculate_requested_order_edit.description: Preview the money effect of removing line items from an order, without changing anything.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…". Find it with search_orders.

line_items.label: Line Items to Remove
line_items.description: The order line items the buyer wants removed and how many units of each. Line item ids come from get_order (line_items[].id). The quantity cannot exceed the unfulfilled quantity of the line item.

list_requested_order_edits.label: List Requested Order Edits
list_requested_order_edits.description: List the edits a buyer requested on an order, such as removing unfulfilled items.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…". Find it with search_orders.

first.label: Page Size
first.description: How many records to return, 1 to 25. Defaults to 25.

after.label: Cursor
after.description: The end_cursor from the previous page. Leave empty for the first page; pass it only while has_next_page is true.

adjust_inventory_quantities.label: Adjust Inventory Quantities
adjust_inventory_quantities.description: Increase or decrease stock by a relative amount at one or more locations.

name.label: Quantity Name
name.description: Which quantity to adjust. Anything other than "available" needs a ledger document URI on each change.

reason.label: Reason
reason.description: Why the stock changes; shown in the inventory history.

changes.label: Changes
changes.description: One entry per inventory item and location.

reference_document_uri.label: Reference Document URI
reference_document_uri.description: Optional URI of the document behind the change, for example "gid://my-app/PurchaseOrder/PO-1".

idempotency_key.label: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: A unique key for this operation, for example a UUID such as "3f1c2a9e-6b1d-4c8e-9a51-2f7d0e4b8c10". Generate your own key on the first call and pass the same key again when retrying after a timeout or error, so Shopify does not repeat the operation. If left empty a key is generated; it is returned as idempotency_key and included in any error message.

approve_comment.label: Approve Blog Comment
approve_comment.description: Approve a blog comment so it is published on the article.

comment_id.label: Comment ID
comment_id.description: The comment id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Comment/…". Find it with list_comments.

archive_order.label: Archive Order

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…". Find it with search_orders.

attach_variant_media.label: Attach Media to Variants
attach_variant_media.description: Show existing product media on specific variants (for example the red photo on the red variant).

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: The product id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Product/…".

variant_media.label: Variant Media
variant_media.description: Which media to attach to which variant, one entry per pair.

bulk_delete_metaobjects.label: Bulk Delete Metaobject Entries
bulk_delete_metaobjects.description: Start deleting many metaobject entries: listed ids, or every entry of one type.

scope.label: Delete Scope
scope.description: BY_IDS deletes only the listed entries; ALL_OF_TYPE deletes every entry of the type.

metaobject_ids.label: Metaobject IDs
metaobject_ids.description: For BY_IDS: entry ids, numeric or "gid://shopify/Metaobject/…", 1 to 250.

type.label: Metaobject Type
type.description: For ALL_OF_TYPE: the metaobject type whose entries are all deleted, for example "designer".

calculate_refund.label: Calculate Refund
calculate_refund.description: Preview the refund Shopify suggests for an order, without refunding.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…". Find it with search_orders.

line_items.label: Line Items to Refund
line_items.description: Line items and quantities to refund. Line item ids come from get_order.

refund_shipping.label: Refund All Shipping
refund_shipping.description: Include the full shipping cost in the suggestion. Off by default.

shipping_amount.label: Shipping Amount
shipping_amount.description: Refund only this much shipping, for example 4.50. Ignored when refunding all shipping.

suggest_full_refund.label: Suggest Full Refund
suggest_full_refund.description: Suggest refunding everything still refundable on the order. Off by default.

cancel_bulk_operation.label: Cancel Bulk Operation
cancel_bulk_operation.description: Stop a running bulk query or bulk mutation.

bulk_operation_id.label: Bulk Operation ID
bulk_operation_id.description: The bulk operation id, numeric or "gid://shopify/BulkOperation/…". Find running ones with list_bulk_operations.

cancel_fulfillment_order.label: Cancel Fulfillment Order
cancel_fulfillment_order.description: Cancel a fulfillment order that was sent to a fulfillment service; a replacement is created.

fulfillment_order_id.label: Fulfillment Order ID
fulfillment_order_id.description: The fulfillment order to cancel, numeric or "gid://shopify/FulfillmentOrder/…". Find it with list_order_fulfillment_orders.

cancel_fulfillment.label: Cancel Fulfillment
cancel_fulfillment.description: Cancel a fulfillment so its items become unfulfilled again.

fulfillment_id.label: Fulfillment ID
fulfillment_id.description: The fulfillment to cancel, numeric or "gid://shopify/Fulfillment/…". Find it with list_order_fulfillments.

capture_order_payment.label: Capture Order Payment
capture_order_payment.description: Capture money from an authorized payment on an order.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…".

parent_transaction_id.label: Authorization Transaction ID
parent_transaction_id.description: The AUTHORIZATION transaction to capture, numeric or "gid://shopify/OrderTransaction/…". Find it with list_order_transactions.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Amount to capture, for example 49.99. Cannot exceed the authorized amount still capturable.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency of the amount, for example "EUR". Required when the order was paid in a currency other than the shop currency.

final_capture.label: Final Capture
final_capture.description: For payments that allow several captures: Yes releases the rest of the authorization after this capture. Leave empty for the gateway default.

complete_draft_order.label: Complete Draft Order
complete_draft_order.description: Turn a draft order into a real order.

draft_order_id.label: Draft Order ID
draft_order_id.description: The draft order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/DraftOrder/…". Find it with list_draft_orders.

payment_gateway_id.label: Payment Gateway ID
payment_gateway_id.description: Optional manual payment gateway to record the payment against, as a full id such as "gid://shopify/PaymentGateway/1".

source_name.label: Source Name
source_name.description: Optional channel label stored on the order, for example "phone".

count_abandoned_checkouts.label: Count Abandoned Checkouts

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify search syntax, for example "created_at:>=2026-09-01". Leave empty to count all.

count_blogs.label: Count Blogs
count_blogs.description: Count the blogs of the online store, optionally filtered.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify blog search syntax, for example "title:News". Leave empty to count all.

count_catalogs.label: Count Catalogs
count_catalogs.description: Count the store's catalogs, optionally by type or search.

type.label: Catalog Type
type.description: Only count catalogs of this type. Leave empty for all types.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify catalog search syntax, for example "status:ACTIVE" or "title:wholesale". Leave empty to count all.

count_collections.label: Count Collections

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify collection search syntax, for example "collection_type:custom". Leave empty to count all.

count_customer_segments.label: Count Customer Segments
count_customer_segments.description: Count the customer segments defined in the store.

count_customers.label: Count Customers

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Filter by created_at, updated_at or id, for example "created_at:>2026-01-01". Leave empty to count all.

count_discount_codes.label: Count Discount Codes
count_discount_codes.description: Count the redeem codes across the store's code discounts, optionally filtered.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Optional Shopify search syntax on the codes, for example "times_used:0". Leave empty to count all.

count_discounts.label: Count Discounts
count_discounts.description: Count discounts (code and automatic), optionally filtered.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify discount search syntax, for example "status:active method:code". Leave empty to count all.

count_draft_orders.label: Count Draft Orders

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify draft order search syntax, for example "status:open". Leave empty to count all.

count_events.label: Count Store Events
count_events.description: Count store activity-log events, optionally filtered.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify event search syntax, for example "subject_type:'ORDER'" or "created_at:>2026-09-01". Leave empty to count all.

count_gift_cards.label: Count Gift Cards

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify gift card search syntax, for example "status:enabled". Leave empty to count all.

count_locations.label: Count Locations
count_locations.description: Count the store's locations, optionally filtered.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify location search syntax, for example "name:Warehouse*". Leave empty to count all.

count_pages.label: Count Online Store Pages
count_pages.description: Count the online store's content pages.

count_products.label: Count Products

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify product search syntax, for example "status:active" or "tag:sale". Leave empty to count all.

count_url_redirects.label: Count URL Redirects
count_url_redirects.description: Count the online store's URL redirects, optionally filtered.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Shopify redirect search syntax, for example "path:/collections". Leave empty to count all.

create_article.label: Create Blog Article
create_article.description: Write a new article in an existing blog.

blog_id.label: Blog ID
blog_id.description: The blog to write in, numeric or "gid://shopify/Blog/…". Find it with list_blogs.

title.label: Title
title.description: Article title, for example "Our summer collection is here".

author_name.label: Author Name
author_name.description: Name shown as the author, for example "Jane Doe".

body_html.label: Body (HTML)
body_html.description:
Article content, HTML allowed, for example "

Hello

".

summary_html.label: Summary (HTML)
summary_html.description: Short excerpt shown in blog listings, HTML allowed.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags for the article, for example ["news", "summer"].

is_published.label: Published
is_published.description: Yes publishes the article on the storefront. Leave empty or No to keep it hidden.

publish_date.label: Publish Date
publish_date.description: Publication date and time, ISO 8601, for example "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z". It does not publish or schedule the article on its own; Published must be Yes as well.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: URL handle, for example "summer-collection". Leave empty to generate it from the title.

image_url.label: Image URL
image_url.description: Public URL of the featured image, for example "https://example.com/banner.jpg".

image_alt_text.label: Image Alt Text
image_alt_text.description: Alternative text for the featured image. Needs image_url.

template_suffix.label: Template Suffix
template_suffix.description: Theme template suffix, for example "wide". Leave empty for the default template.

create_basic_discount_code.label: Create Amount-Off Discount Code
create_basic_discount_code.description: Create a percentage or fixed-amount discount that customers apply with a code.

title.label: Title
title.description: Internal title shown in the admin, for example "Spring sale 15%".

code.label: Code
code.description: The code customers enter at checkout, for example "SPRING15".

value_type.label: Value Type
value_type.description: Percentage off or a fixed amount off.

value.label: Value
value.description: For PERCENTAGE the percent, 15 means 15% off (above 0, at most 100). For FIXED_AMOUNT the amount in the shop currency, for example 10.

applies_on_each_item.label: Apply Amount To Each Item
applies_on_each_item.description: FIXED_AMOUNT only: Yes takes the amount off every eligible item, No takes it off once per order. Leave unset for Shopify's default.

applies_to.label: Applies To
applies_to.description: What the discount applies to. Leave unset to infer it from the ids: PRODUCTS when product_ids or variant_ids are given, COLLECTIONS when collection_ids are given, ALL items when no ids are given.

product_ids.label: Product IDs
product_ids.description: With applies_to PRODUCTS: product ids, numeric or "gid://shopify/Product/…".

variant_ids.label: Variant IDs
variant_ids.description: With applies_to PRODUCTS: variant ids, numeric or "gid://shopify/ProductVariant/…".

collection_ids.label: Collection IDs
collection_ids.description: With applies_to COLLECTIONS: collection ids, numeric or "gid://shopify/Collection/…".

eligibility.label: Eligibility

create_free_shipping_discount_code.description: Create a free shipping discount that customers apply with a code.

fulfillment_id.label: Fulfillment ID
fulfillment_id.description: The fulfillment id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Fulfillment/…". Find it with list_order_fulfillments.

status.label: Status
status.description: The shipment status this event reports.

message.label: Message
message.description: Optional message, for example "Arrived at sorting facility".

happened_at.label: Happened At
happened_at.description: When the event happened, ISO 8601. Defaults to now on Shopify's side.

estimated_delivery_at.label: Estimated Delivery At
estimated_delivery_at.description: The new estimated delivery time, ISO 8601.

city.label: City
city.description: City where the event happened, for example "Memphis".

province.label: Province
province.description: Province or state where the event happened, for example "Tennessee".

country.label: Country
country.description: Country where the event happened, for example "United States".

fulfillment_order_id.description: The fulfillment order to fulfill, numeric or "gid://shopify/FulfillmentOrder/…". Find it with list_order_fulfillment_orders.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: Optional partial shipment: the fulfillment order line items and quantities to ship. Leave empty to ship all remaining items of the fulfillment order.

tracking_company.label: Tracking Company
tracking_company.description: The carrier name, for example "UPS", "USPS", "FedEx" or "DHL Express". With a supported carrier Shopify builds the tracking URL itself.

tracking_numbers.label: Tracking Numbers
tracking_numbers.description: One or more tracking numbers, for example "1Z999AA10123456784".

tracking_urls.label: Tracking URLs
tracking_urls.description: Tracking page URLs, one per tracking number, for example "https://www.ups.com/track?tracknum=1Z999AA10123456784". Only needed for carriers Shopify does not know.

notify_customer.label: Notify Customer

create_gift_card.description: Issue a new gift card with an initial balance.

amount.description: The starting balance, for example 50 for 50.00.

currency.description: ISO currency code of the amount, for example "USD". Normally the shop currency.

code.description: Optional custom code customers type at checkout, letters and numbers only, for example "WELCOME2026GIFT". Leave empty for a random 16-character code.

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: Optional customer who owns the card, numeric or "gid://shopify/Customer/…".

expires_on.label: Expires On
expires_on.description: Optional expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2027-12-31". Leave empty for no expiry.

note.label: Note
note.description: Optional internal note, not shown to the customer.

recipient_customer_id.label: Recipient Customer ID
recipient_customer_id.description: Optional customer who receives the gift card notification, numeric or "gid://shopify/Customer/…". Needed for the recipient message and notification time.

recipient_preferred_name.label: Recipient Preferred Name
recipient_preferred_name.description: Optional name used to greet the recipient, for example "Sam".

recipient_message.label: Recipient Message
recipient_message.description: Optional personal message included in the recipient notification.

send_notification_at.label: Send Notification At
send_notification_at.description: Optional time to email the recipient, ISO 8601. Leave empty to send when Shopify processes it.

create_marketing_engagement.description: Report one day of engagement metrics for a marketing activity or channel.

marketing_activity_id.label: Marketing Activity ID
marketing_activity_id.description: The activity id, numeric or "gid://shopify/MarketingActivity/…". Use this, the remote id, or a channel handle.

remote_id.label: Remote ID
remote_id.description: Your own id the activity was created with, for example "fb-campaign-2026-spring".

channel_handle.label: Channel Handle
channel_handle.description: For channel-level metrics only: the channel handle your Shopify partner manager gave you. Leave empty for activity metrics.

occurred_on.label: Day
occurred_on.description: The day the metrics cover, YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2026-09-22".

utc_offset.label: UTC Offset
utc_offset.description: Time zone offset of that day, for example "+00:00" or "-05:00".

impressions_count.label: Impressions
impressions_count.description: Times the content was shown that day.

fails_count.label: Failed Sends
fails_count.description: Messages that failed to send that day.

sessions_count.label: Sessions
sessions_count.description: Store sessions from the activity that day.

orders.label: Orders
orders.description: Orders attributed to the activity that day (may be fractional for shared attribution).

ad_spend_amount.label: Ad Spend
ad_spend_amount.description: Amount spent that day, in the currency below.

sales_amount.label: Sales
sales_amount.description: Sales attributed that day, in the currency below.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code of ad spend and sales, for example "USD". Needed when either is set.

create_order_risk_assessment.label: Create Order Risk Assessment
create_order_risk_assessment.description: Record a fraud risk assessment with supporting facts on an order.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…". Find it with search_orders.

facts.label: Facts
facts.description: Reasons behind the assessment, at least one.

create_order_with_line_items.description: Create a real order with one or more line items.

line_items.description: The items to order. Give either a variant id (price comes from the product) or a title and price for a custom item.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for every price given here, for example "USD". Required when any unit price, shipping price or fixed discount is given. Find the shop currency with get_shop.

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: Existing customer to attach, numeric or "gid://shopify/Customer/…". Find it with search_customers.

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: Order contact phone in E.164 format, for example "+16135551111".

financial_status.label: Financial Status
financial_status.description: Payment status of the order. Authorized, Paid and Partially paid need payment_amount, which records a manual payment; without it Shopify would only show the label and the order could not be refunded, captured or marked as paid. Leave empty for pending.

payment_amount.label: Payment Amount
payment_amount.description: Amount already paid (Paid, Partially paid) or authorized (Authorized), recorded as a manual payment in the order currency, for example 40.5. Needed with those financial statuses.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags to set on the order, for example ["wholesale", "phone-order"].

discount_code.label: Discount Code
discount_code.description: One discount code to record on the order, for example "SUMMER10". Only one code is allowed.

discount_type.label: Discount Type
discount_type.description: How the discount code applies. Required with a discount code.

discount_value.label: Discount Value
discount_value.description: Percentage (for example 10 for 10%) or fixed amount, depending on the discount type.

shipping_title.label: Shipping Line Title
shipping_title.description: Name of the shipping method, for example "Standard Shipping". Needs a shipping price.

shipping_price.label: Shipping Price
shipping_price.description: Shipping price in the order currency, for example 5.00 (use 0 for free shipping). Required together with the shipping line title, and needs a currency.

shipping_first_name.label: Shipping First Name
shipping_first_name.description: First name on the shipping address.

shipping_last_name.label: Shipping Last Name
shipping_last_name.description: Last name on the shipping address.

shipping_address1.label: Shipping Address Line 1
shipping_address1.description: Street address, for example "150 Elgin Street".

shipping_country_code.label: Shipping Country Code
shipping_country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code, for example "CA".

inventory_behaviour.label: Inventory Behaviour
inventory_behaviour.description: Whether to decrement stock. Leave empty for the Shopify default (bypass, stock is not changed).

send_receipt.label: Send Order Receipt
send_receipt.description: Email the order confirmation to the customer. Off by default.

send_fulfillment_receipt.label: Send Fulfillment Receipt
send_fulfillment_receipt.description: Email a shipping confirmation when the order is fulfilled. Off by default.

fulfillment_location_id.label: Fulfilled From Location ID
fulfillment_location_id.description: Set only when importing an order that was already shipped: the location id (from list_locations) it shipped from. The order is then created fulfilled for all line items. Leave empty for an unfulfilled order.

tracking_numbers.label: Tracking Numbers
tracking_numbers.description: Tracking numbers of the imported fulfillment, one per package, for example ["1Z999AA10123456784", "1Z999AA10123456785"]. Needs fulfillment_location_id.

tracking_company.label: Tracking Company
tracking_company.description: Carrier of the tracking numbers, for example "UPS", "USPS" or "DHL Express". Needs fulfillment_location_id.

create_page.label: Create Online Store Page

Shipping

We ship worldwide.

".

handle.label: Handle

is_published.label: Published

publish_date.label: Publish Date
publish_date.description: Publication date and time, ISO 8601, for example "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z". It does not publish or schedule the page on its own; Published must be Yes as well.

template_suffix.label: Template Suffix
template_suffix.description: Theme template suffix, for example "contact" for page.contact.json. Leave empty for the default template.

options.label: Options
options.description: The options to add, for example Color with values "Red, Blue".

variant_strategy.label: Variant Strategy
variant_strategy.description: What happens to variants. Defaults to leaving existing variants as they are.

options.label: Create variants for every new combination

description_html.label: Description (HTML)

".

vendor.label: Vendor

collection_ids.label: Collection IDs

create_product_variants.description: Add one or more variants to a product.

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: The product id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Product/…". Find it with search_products.

variants.label: Variants
variants.description: The variants to create, one entry per variant. Each needs option values for every product option.

strategy.label: Default Variant Handling
strategy.description: What happens to the placeholder variant of a product without options. Leave empty for the Shopify default.

create_refund.label: Create Refund
create_refund.description: Refund money and/or line items on an order.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…". Find it with search_orders.

line_items.label: Line Items to Refund
line_items.description: Line items and quantities to refund. Line item ids come from get_order.

transactions.description: The money to return, one entry per original payment. refund_shipping.label: Refund All Shipping
refund_shipping.description: Refund the full remaining shipping cost. Off by default.

notify_customer.label: Notify Customer
notify_customer.description: Email the customer a refund notification. Off by default.

description_html.label: Description (HTML)
description_html.description: New description, HTML allowed. Replaces the existing description.

redirect_new_handle.label: Redirect Old Handle
redirect_new_handle.description: When changing the handle, create a redirect from the old URL. Leave empty for the Shopify default.

sort_order.label: Product Sort Order
sort_order.description: How products are ordered inside the collection. Manual is required before reorder_collection_products.

image_url.label: Image URL
image_url.description: Public URL of a new collection image.

image_alt_text.label: Image Alt Text
image_alt_text.description: Alt text for the new image. Only used together with an image URL.

seo_title.label: SEO Title
seo_title.description: New page title for search engines.

seo_description.label: SEO Description
seo_description.description: New meta description for search engines.

source_id.label: Conditions Source ID
source_id.description: The conditions source to edit (from get_collection sources). Required for the condition fields below.

match_type.label: Match
match_type.description: Switch the source between matching all conditions or any of them.

conditions_to_add.label: Conditions
conditions_to_add.description: New conditions to add to the source. Existing conditions are kept.

condition_ids_to_delete.label: Condition IDs to Delete
condition_ids_to_delete.description: Ids of conditions to remove (from get_collection sources[].conditions).

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Shop currency code for new price conditions, for example "USD".

update_customer_address.label: Update Customer Address
update_customer_address.description: Change fields of a saved customer address.

address_id.label: Address ID
address_id.description: The address id from list_customer_addresses, for example "gid://shopify/MailingAddress/1053318585?model_name=CustomerAddress" or its number.

address1.label: Address Line 1
address1.description: Street address, for example "150 Elgin Street".

address2.label: Address Line 2
address2.description: Apartment, suite or unit, for example "Suite 800".

country_code.label: Country Code
country_code.description: Two-letter ISO country code, for example "CA" or "US".

zip.label: Postal Code
zip.description: Postal or ZIP code, for example "K2P 1L4".

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format, for example "+16135551111".

set_as_default.label: Set as Default
set_as_default.description: Yes makes this the customer's default address. Leave empty to leave the default unchanged.

update_customer_profile.label: Update Customer
update_customer_profile.description: Change the name, email, phone, note, tags, locale or tax exemption of a customer.

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: The customer id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Customer/…". Find it with search_customers.

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: New phone in E.164 format, for example "+16135551111".

note.label: Note
note.description: New internal note. Replaces the existing note.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: The complete new tag list. Replaces every existing tag; leave empty to keep the current tags (use clear_tags to remove all).

locale.label: Locale
locale.description: Language for customer emails, for example "en" or "fr-CA".

tax_exempt.label: Tax Exempt
tax_exempt.description: Set whether the customer is exempt from taxes. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

clear_note.label: Clear Note
clear_note.description: Remove the existing note. Leave note empty when using this.

clear_tags.label: Clear Tags
clear_tags.description: Remove every tag. Leave tags empty when using this.

update_draft_order.label: Update Draft Order
update_draft_order.description: Change the line items, customer, contact, tags or payment terms of a draft order.

draft_order_id.label: Draft Order ID
draft_order_id.description: The draft order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/DraftOrder/…". Find it with list_draft_orders.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: The complete new list of line items. Replaces every existing line item; leave empty to keep the current items.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency for the unit prices given in line items, for example "USD".

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: Customer the draft is for, numeric or "gid://shopify/Customer/…".

email.label: Email
email.description: Email the invoice is sent to.

note.label: Note
note.description: New internal note. Replaces the existing note.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: The complete new tag list. Replaces every existing tag; leave empty to keep the current tags (use clear_tags to remove all).

payment_terms_template_id.label: Payment Terms Template ID
payment_terms_template_id.description: Payment terms to apply, as a full id such as "gid://shopify/PaymentTermsTemplate/4". With payment terms, completing the draft leaves the order payment-pending.

payment_issued_at.label: Payment Terms Issued At
payment_issued_at.description: Start date for net payment terms (for example net 30), ISO 8601.

payment_due_at.label: Payment Due At
payment_due_at.description: Due date for fixed-date payment terms, ISO 8601.

reserve_inventory_until.label: Reserve Inventory Until
reserve_inventory_until.description: Hold the stock for this draft until this time (ISO 8601).

clear_note.label: Clear Note
clear_note.description: Remove the existing note. Leave note empty when using this.

clear_tags.label: Clear Tags
clear_tags.description: Remove every tag. Leave tags empty when using this.

update_external_marketing_activity.label: Update External Marketing Activity
update_external_marketing_activity.description: Change some fields of an external marketing activity.

marketing_activity_id.label: Marketing Activity ID
marketing_activity_id.description: The activity id, numeric or "gid://shopify/MarketingActivity/…". Use this, the remote id, or the UTM values.

remote_id.label: Remote ID
remote_id.description: Your own id the activity was created with, for example "fb-campaign-2026-spring".

utm_campaign.label: UTM Campaign (to find the activity)
utm_campaign.description: utm_campaign the activity was created with. Set all three UTM values to identify the activity by them.

utm_source.label: UTM Source (to find the activity)
utm_source.description: utm_source the activity was created with.

utm_medium.label: UTM Medium (to find the activity)
utm_medium.description: utm_medium the activity was created with.

title.label: Title
title.description: New title.

status.label: Status
status.description: New state of the activity on the external platform.

tactic.label: Tactic
tactic.description: New tactic. An activity cannot be changed to or from STOREFRONT_APP.

remote_url.label: Remote URL
remote_url.description: New URL where the merchant manages the activity.

budget_type.label: Budget Type
budget_type.description: DAILY or LIFETIME. Set together with the budget amount; the pair replaces the stored budget.

budget_amount.label: Budget Amount
budget_amount.description: New budget total, in the currency below.

ad_spend_amount.label: Ad Spend
ad_spend_amount.description: New total spent so far, in the currency below.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code of the budget and ad spend, for example "USD". Needed when either is set.

start.label: Actual Start
start.description: When the activity really started, ISO 8601.

end.label: Actual End
end.description: When the activity really ended, ISO 8601.

update_free_shipping_discount_code.label: Update Free Shipping Discount Code
update_free_shipping_discount_code.description: Change an existing free shipping discount code.

discount_id.label: Discount ID
discount_id.description: The code discount id, for example "gid://shopify/DiscountCodeNode/123" or "123". Get it from list_discounts, get_discount or find_discount_by_code.

title.label: Title
title.description: New internal title. Leave empty to keep it.

code.label: Code
code.description: New code customers enter. Leave empty to keep it.

starts_at.label: Starts At
starts_at.description: New start, ISO 8601. Leave empty to keep it.

ends_at.label: Ends At
ends_at.description: New end, ISO 8601. Leave empty to keep it. To remove the end date use remove_end_date.

remove_end_date.label: Remove End Date
remove_end_date.description: Yes: clear the end date so the code no longer expires. Cannot be combined with ends_at. Leave unset to keep the end date.

destination.label: Destination
destination.description: Where free shipping applies; replaces the current destination. Leave unset to keep it, or to use COUNTRIES when country codes are given.

country_codes_to_add.label: Country Codes To Add
country_codes_to_add.description: With destination COUNTRIES: two-letter ISO country codes where free shipping should apply, for example "US" and "CA".

country_codes_to_remove.label: Country Codes To Remove
country_codes_to_remove.description: With destination COUNTRIES: two-letter ISO country codes to take out, for example "MX".

maximum_shipping_price.label: Maximum Shipping Price
maximum_shipping_price.description: New cap on the shipping rate the code covers, above 0, for example 20. Leave empty to keep it.

eligibility.label: Eligibility
eligibility.description: Who can use the code. Replaces the current eligibility.

customer_ids_to_add.label: Customer IDs To Add
customer_ids_to_add.description: With eligibility CUSTOMERS: customers who can use the code, numeric or "gid://shopify/Customer/…".

customer_ids_to_remove.label: Customer IDs To Remove
customer_ids_to_remove.description: With eligibility CUSTOMERS: customers who should no longer be able to use it.

segment_ids_to_add.label: Segment IDs To Add
segment_ids_to_add.description: With eligibility SEGMENTS: segments that can use the code, numeric or "gid://shopify/Segment/…".

segment_ids_to_remove.label: Segment IDs To Remove
segment_ids_to_remove.description: With eligibility SEGMENTS: segments that should no longer be able to use it.

minimum_requirement.label: Minimum Requirement
minimum_requirement.description: New minimum, or NONE to remove it. Leave unset to keep the current one.

minimum_value.label: Minimum Value
minimum_value.description: With SUBTOTAL or QUANTITY: the subtotal or the whole-number item quantity.

usage_limit.label: Usage Limit
usage_limit.description: New total usage limit, a whole number of 1 or more. Leave empty to keep it. To remove the limit use remove_usage_limit.

remove_usage_limit.label: Remove Usage Limit
remove_usage_limit.description: Yes: clear the total usage limit so the code can be used any number of times. Cannot be combined with usage_limit. Leave unset to keep the limit.

applies_once_per_customer.label: Once Per Customer
applies_once_per_customer.description: Yes: each customer can use it once. No: no per-customer limit. Leave unset to keep it.

combines_with_product_discounts.label: Combines With Product Discounts
combines_with_product_discounts.description: Set all three combines_with choices together; they replace the current combinations.

combines_with_order_discounts.label: Combines With Order Discounts
combines_with_order_discounts.description: Set all three combines_with choices together; they replace the current combinations.

combines_with_shipping_discounts.label: Combines With Shipping Discounts
combines_with_shipping_discounts.description: Set all three combines_with choices together; they replace the current combinations.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: The complete new tag list; replaces the current tags. Leave empty to keep them.

update_fulfillment_tracking.label: Update Fulfillment Tracking
update_fulfillment_tracking.description: Change the carrier, tracking numbers or tracking URLs of a fulfillment.

fulfillment_id.label: Fulfillment ID
fulfillment_id.description: The fulfillment id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Fulfillment/…". Find it with list_order_fulfillments.

tracking_company.label: Tracking Company
tracking_company.description: The carrier name, for example "UPS", "USPS", "FedEx" or "DHL Express".

tracking_numbers.label: Tracking Numbers
tracking_numbers.description: The complete list of tracking numbers. Replaces the stored list; leave empty to keep it.

tracking_urls.label: Tracking URLs
tracking_urls.description: The complete list of tracking page URLs, one per tracking number. Replaces the stored list; leave empty to keep it.

notify_customer.label: Notify Customer
notify_customer.description: Send the customer a shipping update email. Off by default.

update_gift_card.label: Update Gift Card
update_gift_card.description: Change a gift card's note, expiry date, owner or recipient.

gift_card_id.label: Gift Card ID
gift_card_id.description: The gift card id, numeric or "gid://shopify/GiftCard/…". Find it with search_gift_cards.

note.label: Note
note.description: New internal note. Leave empty to keep the current one.

expires_on.label: Expires On
expires_on.description: New expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2027-12-31". Leave empty to keep the current one.

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: New owner customer, numeric or "gid://shopify/Customer/…". Leave empty to keep the current owner.

template_suffix.label: Template Suffix
template_suffix.description: Theme template suffix for the gift card page, for example "birthday". Leave empty to keep it.

recipient_customer_id.label: Recipient Customer ID
recipient_customer_id.description: Customer who receives the gift card notification, numeric or "gid://shopify/Customer/…". Required to change any recipient detail.

recipient_preferred_name.label: Recipient Preferred Name
recipient_preferred_name.description: Name used to greet the recipient, for example "Sam".

recipient_message.label: Recipient Message
recipient_message.description: Personal message included in the recipient notification.

send_notification_at.label: Send Notification At
send_notification_at.description: Time to email the recipient, ISO 8601.

update_inventory_item.label: Update Inventory Item
update_inventory_item.description: Change the SKU, unit cost, tracking, shipping, weight or customs data of an inventory item.

inventory_item_id.label: Inventory Item ID
inventory_item_id.description: The inventory item id, numeric or "gid://shopify/InventoryItem/…" (from get_product_variant_details).

cost.label: Unit Cost
cost.description: New unit cost in the shop currency, for example 7.50.

tracked.label: Track Quantity
tracked.description: Whether Shopify tracks stock for this item. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

requires_shipping.label: Requires Shipping
requires_shipping.description: Whether the item is a physical product that needs shipping. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

country_code_of_origin.label: Country of Origin
country_code_of_origin.description: Two-letter ISO country code where the item was made, for example "CN".

province_code_of_origin.label: Province of Origin
province_code_of_origin.description: Province or state code of origin, for example "ON".

harmonized_system_code.label: HS Code
harmonized_system_code.description: Harmonized System code for customs, for example "6109.10".

weight_value.label: Weight
weight_value.description: Item weight, for example 0.25. Set together with the weight unit.

update_metafield_definition.label: Update Metafield Definition
update_metafield_definition.description: Change a metafield definition's name, description or validation rules.

owner_type.label: Owner Type
owner_type.description: The resource type of the definition, for example PRODUCT.

name.label: Name
name.description: New display name, for example "Care instructions".

validations.label: Validations
validations.description: The complete new list of validation rules; replaces every existing rule. Leave empty to keep the current rules.

remove_all_validations.label: Remove All Validations
remove_all_validations.description: Yes removes every validation rule. Cannot be combined with validations.

update_order_details.label: Update Order Details
update_order_details.description: Change the email, phone, note, tags or PO number of an order.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: The order id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Order/…". Find it with search_orders.

phone.label: Phone
phone.description: New contact phone in E.164 format, for example "+16135551111".

note.label: Note
note.description: New internal note. Replaces the existing note.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: The complete new tag list, for example ["wholesale", "priority"]. Replaces every existing tag; leave empty to keep the current tags (use clear_tags to remove all).

clear_note.label: Clear Note
clear_note.description: Remove the existing note. Leave note empty when using this.

clear_tags.label: Clear Tags
clear_tags.description: Remove every tag. Leave tags empty when using this.

update_page.label: Update Online Store Page
update_page.description: Change a content page's title, body, handle, template or publish state.

page_id.label: Page ID
page_id.description: The page id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Page/…". Find it with list_pages.

title.label: Title
title.description: New title.

body_html.label: Body (HTML)
body_html.description: New page content, HTML allowed. Replaces the whole body.

redirect_new_handle.label: Redirect Old Handle
redirect_new_handle.description: When changing the handle, create a redirect from the old URL. Leave empty for the Shopify default.

is_published.label: Published
is_published.description: Yes publishes the page, No hides it. Leave empty to keep the current state.

publish_date.label: Publish Date
publish_date.description: New publication date and time, ISO 8601.

clear_body.label: Clear Body
clear_body.description: Remove the existing content. Leave body_html empty when using this.

update_product_fields.label: Update Product
update_product_fields.description: Change the title, description, vendor, type, status, handle, tags, category, SEO or collections of a product.

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: The product id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Product/…". Find it with search_products.

title.label: Title
title.description: New product title.

description_html.label: Description (HTML)
description_html.description: New description, HTML allowed. Replaces the existing description.

status.label: Status
status.description: New status. Leave empty to keep the current status.

redirect_new_handle.label: Redirect Old Handle
redirect_new_handle.description: When changing the handle, create a redirect from the old URL. Leave empty for the Shopify default.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: The complete new tag list. Replaces every existing tag; leave empty to keep the current tags.

category_id.label: Category ID
category_id.description: New taxonomy category id, for example "gid://shopify/TaxonomyCategory/aa-1-13-8".

collections_to_join.label: Collections to Join
collections_to_join.description: Collection ids to add the product to, numeric or "gid://shopify/Collection/…".

collections_to_leave.label: Collections to Leave
collections_to_leave.description: Collection ids to remove the product from.

seo_title.label: SEO Title
seo_title.description: New page title for search engines.

seo_description.label: SEO Description
seo_description.description: New meta description for search engines.

update_product_media.label: Update Product Media
update_product_media.description: Change the alt text, filename or image of an existing media file.

media_id.label: Media ID
media_id.description: The media id, for example "gid://shopify/MediaImage/1072273219". Find it with list_product_media.

alt.label: Alt Text
alt.description: New accessible description, for example "Red t-shirt, back view".

filename.label: Filename
filename.description: New filename with the same extension, for example "red-shirt-back.jpg".

replacement_url.label: Replacement Image URL
replacement_url.description: Public URL of a new image that replaces the file content, for example "https://example.com/new.jpg". Images only.

update_product_option.label: Update Product Option
update_product_option.description: Rename or move a product option and add, rename or delete its values.

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: The product id, numeric or "gid://shopify/Product/…".

option_id.label: Option ID
option_id.description: The option id, for example "gid://shopify/ProductOption/1064576516". Find it with get_product_details.

position.label: New Position
position.description: New position of the option, starting at 1.

values_to_add.label: Values to Add
values_to_add.description: New values for this option, for example ["Purple"].

value_ids_to_delete.label: Value IDs to Delete
value_ids_to_delete.description: Ids of option values to delete.

variant_strategy.label: Variant Strategy
variant_strategy.description: How variants follow value changes. Leave empty for the Shopify default (leave variants as they are).

options.label: Manage variants (create and delete as needed)

update_product_variants.label: Update Product Variants
update_product_variants.description: Change the price, SKU, barcode, stock policy or option values of one or more variants of a product.

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: The product the variants belong to, numeric or "gid://shopify/Product/…".

variants.label: Variants
variants.description: The variants to change, one entry per variant. Fields left empty keep their values.

update_script_tag.label: Update Script Tag
update_script_tag.description: Change the script URL or cache flag of a script tag.

script_tag_id.label: Script Tag ID
script_tag_id.description: The script tag id, numeric or "gid://shopify/ScriptTag/…". Find it with list_script_tags.

src.label: Script URL
src.description: New HTTPS URL of the JavaScript file.

cache.label: Cache
cache.description: Yes serves the script from Shopify's CDN cache, No loads it from the source each time. Leave empty to keep the current setting.

update_theme.label: Rename Theme

theme_id.label: Theme ID
theme_id.description: The theme id, numeric or "gid://shopify/OnlineStoreTheme/…". Find it with list_themes.

name.label: New Name
name.description: The new theme name, for example "Dawn - holiday edit".

update_url_redirect.label: Update URL Redirect
update_url_redirect.description: Change the old path or the target of a URL redirect.

url_redirect_id.label: URL Redirect ID
url_redirect_id.description: The redirect id, numeric or "gid://shopify/UrlRedirect/…". Find it with list_url_redirects.

path.label: Old Path
path.description: New path to redirect from, starting with "/".

target.label: Target
target.description: New target path or full URL.

upsert_external_marketing_activity.label: Upsert External Marketing Activity
upsert_external_marketing_activity.description: Create or fully replace an external marketing activity, keyed by your remote id.

remote_id.label: Remote ID
remote_id.description: Your own unique id for this activity, for example "fb-campaign-2026-spring". The same remote id updates the same activity.

title.label: Title
title.description: Name shown in the Shopify marketing section, for example "Spring sale Facebook ads".

status.label: Status
status.description: Current state of the activity on the external platform.

remote_url.label: Remote URL
remote_url.description: URL where the merchant manages this activity on the external platform, for example "https://ads.example.com/campaigns/42".

tactic.label: Tactic
tactic.description: The kind of marketing, for example AD, NEWSLETTER or POST.

marketing_channel_type.label: Channel Type
marketing_channel_type.description: The channel the activity runs on.

utm_campaign.label: UTM Campaign
utm_campaign.description: utm_campaign value of the activity links, for example "spring-sale". Set all three UTM values or none. Cannot be changed later.

url_parameter_value.label: URL Parameter Value
url_parameter_value.description: Value of the tracking URL parameter used instead of UTM values. Cannot be changed later.

hierarchy_level.label: Hierarchy Level
hierarchy_level.description: Optional level when the activity is part of a campaign tree (CAMPAIGN, AD_GROUP or AD). Cannot be changed later.

parent_remote_id.label: Parent Remote ID
parent_remote_id.description: Remote id of the parent activity in the campaign tree. Cannot be changed later.

channel_handle.label: Channel Handle
channel_handle.description: Handle of the sales channel the activity belongs to, if your partner manager gave you one. Cannot be changed later.

referring_domain.label: Referring Domain
referring_domain.description: Domain visitors arrive from, for example "facebook.com".

remote_preview_image_url.label: Preview Image URL
remote_preview_image_url.description: Public URL of a preview image of the ad or email.

budget_type.label: Budget Type
budget_type.description: DAILY or LIFETIME. Set together with the budget amount.

budget_amount.label: Budget Amount
budget_amount.description: Budget total, for example 500 for 500.00, in the currency below.

ad_spend_amount.label: Ad Spend
ad_spend_amount.description: Amount spent so far, in the currency below.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code of the budget and ad spend, for example "USD". Needed when either is set.

start.label: Actual Start
start.description: When the activity really started, ISO 8601.

end.label: Actual End
end.description: When the activity really ended, ISO 8601.

upsert_metaobject.label: Create or Update Metaobject Entry
upsert_metaobject.description: Create a metaobject entry, or update the fields you send on an existing one, by type and handle.

type.label: Metaobject Type
type.description: The metaobject definition type, for example "designer". Find it with list_metaobject_definitions.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: Unique handle of the entry within its type, for example "ada-lovelace". Reusing an existing handle updates that entry.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Field values to write; fields you leave out keep their current values.

status.label: Status
status.description: DRAFT hides the entry from the storefront, ACTIVE shows it. Only for publishable types; leave empty to keep the current status.

template_suffix.label: Template Suffix
template_suffix.description: Online store template suffix for the entry's page. Only for types with the online store capability.

upsert_theme_files.label: Create or Update Theme Files
upsert_theme_files.description: Create theme files or overwrite existing ones (up to 50 per call).

theme_id.label: Theme ID
theme_id.description: The theme id, numeric or "gid://shopify/OnlineStoreTheme/…". Find it with list_themes.

files.label: Files
files.description: One entry per file, 1 to 50, each path at most once.

void_order_transaction.label: Void Payment Authorization
void_order_transaction.description: Void an uncaptured payment authorization on an order.

parent_transaction_id.label: Authorization Transaction ID
parent_transaction_id.description: The AUTHORIZATION transaction to void, numeric or "gid://shopify/OrderTransaction/…". Find it with list_order_transactions.

new_cancelled_order.label: New Cancelled Order
new_cancelled_order.description: Triggers when an order is cancelled.

new_customer.label: New Customer
new_customer.description: Triggers when a customer is created.

new_order.label: New Order
new_order.description: Triggers when an order is created.

updated_product.label: Updated Product
updated_product.description: Triggers when a product is updated.

new_paid_order.label: New Paid Order
new_paid_order.description: Triggers when an order is paid.

new_abandoned_checkout.label: New Abandoned Checkout
new_abandoned_checkout.description: Triggers when a checkout is abandoned.
